discovery_policy: Primary sources only for admission; secondary search results can be leads. Preserve executed queries, inspected URLs, failed access and every screened candidate. No model outputs or reference answers drive selection. Stop at bounded search; report shortfall.
required_fields: Explicit original erroneous assertion or quoted erroneous wording with original-version limits
An explicit correction replacing that assertion, attributed to the asserting authority
A downstream assertion present in a source, with essential dependence grounded in text or a source-specified computation, not topical similarity
An independently supported unaffected claim or component as retention control
dependency_policy: Downstream questions may be authored, but the underlying dependent assertion and essential support relation must be source-grounded. Author-invented arithmetic thresholds, guessed causal links, and paraphrases of the corrected assertion are not positive dependency cases. Alternative independent support must be recorded; correction of one premise need not withdraw a conclusion supported independently.

strata.paired_prefix_ready: Actual earlier captured version plus correction/version evidence; historical first public availability remains separate unless independently certified.
strata.current_document_only: Current correction document can support a clearly labelled mechanism illustration, without deleting its update to invent an earlier information state.
strata.discovery_only: Missing dependency, control, explicit replacement, accessible full text or unsupported core semantics. No method result.

representation_policy: Whole-assertion replacement only in current core. Pure retraction, partial-field change, changed measurement time/scope and update-policy reversals must be marked separately, not coerced. Scalar claims may be atomic only when text supports an independently meaningful assertion.
admission_sequence: Discovery screen, exact capture freeze, separate source-only eligibility adjudication, then questions/proposals and model outputs. Preserve ambiguous/excluded cases.
negative_controls: Ordinary succession and plan revision are not correction positives; existing v09 sources can later supply controls.
novelty_limit: No new algorithm or empirical gain claimed. Eight eligible histories would only license a development test.
